headline: High Energy Costs Weigh on 2Q; Stable Pricing, Capacity Expansion, and Cost Savings to Support Medium-Term Growth

highlights: The upcoming 6.8mtpa eastern expansion by Mar-28 and the 1.1mtpa entry into Central India are expected to drive the next phase of growth.
Despite seasonal disruptions, particularly in the east, volume growth stood at 4.9% YoY in 2QFY27 and 6.7% in 1HFY27.
The upcoming expansions are expected to translate into meaningful volume growth as new capacities ramp up.
valuation: Outlook and valuation: We roll forward our estimates to FY29E and project revenue, EBITDA, and Adj.
We maintain our valuation multiple at 9.5x Sep-28E forward EV/EBITDA and revise our target price to Rs576 (from Rs693), implying 22% upside, while retaining our BUY rating.
The unchanged multiple reflects the potential for limited impact of incremental cost pressure, volume growth from capacity additions in FY29E, and the stock’s current valuation near its 52-week low.
watch: With 18mtpa of installed capacity and 74% capacity utilisation, the company has sufficient headroom to cater to incremental demand across its key markets.
The limited increase in other expenses, despite operating deleverage and industry-wide packing-cost concerns, is also encouraging.
